verdicts.reason: The two candidates look pixel-identical, and both have the same flaws. The beige brush-stroke swatch has come loose from the headline and now floats as an empty, ragged shape near the top. The subtitle 'Weekly SPA items review' is far too large next to 'Spa Utopia' and wraps with 'review' left alone on its own line. The bottom ~30% of the canvas is empty beige. The product imagery is cropped down to fragments of a jar and a glass, and the green dropper bottles are gone, so much of the original's spa product feel is lost.
